name: albany_real_estate
description: An interactive data intelligence application for exploring Albany, NY property assessment data from the 2025 Final Assessment Roll.

scripts.refresh:data: npm run convert:roll && npm run prepare:data && npm run build:roll
scripts.check:publish: npm run build && npm run build:site
scripts.extract:roll-pdf: python extract-roll-pdf.py "Albany 2026 Final Roll.pdf" "Albany 2026 Final Roll.txt"
scripts.convert:roll-prior: node convert-roll.js "Albany 2025 Final Roll.txt" albany-roll-2025.full.json && node prepare-albany-data.js albany-roll-2025.full.json Albany_County_Parcels_2024_-1728787929616575091.csv albany-parcel-geometry.json albany-roll-2025.full.json
